command:
import collections, hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
root, evidence = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:3])
receipt = {"command": ["timeout", "--kill-after=5s", "120s", *sys.orig_argv], "source_commit": sys.argv[3], "passed": False}
code = 1
try:
    result = json.loads((evidence / "raw/closure.json").read_text())
    frozen = json.loads((root / "docs/operations/evidence/issue-92-pr6b/review/lines.json").read_text())
    selected = [line for line in frozen if line["category"] in ("missing test", "unresolved")]
    expected = {str(identifier): line["line_key"] for line in selected for identifier in line["mutant_ids"]}
    assert len(selected) == 136 and len(expected) == 228
    rows = result["rows"]
    actual = {str(row["original_id"]): row["line_key"] for row in rows}
    assert len(rows) == len(actual) == 228 and actual == expected
    assert result["inventory"]["lines"] == 136 and result["inventory"]["variants"] == 228
    counts = result["status_counts"]
    allowed = {"Killed", "Timeout", "Survived", "NoCoverage", "CompileError", "Ignored"}
    assert set(counts) <= allowed
    assert all(type(count) is int and count >= 0 for count in counts.values())
    assert sum(counts.values()) == result["serialized_count"] <= 10000
    numerator = counts.get("Killed", 0) + counts.get("Timeout", 0)
    denominator = numerator + counts.get("Survived", 0) + counts.get("NoCoverage", 0)
    assert result["score"]["numerator"] == numerator
    assert result["score"]["denominator"] == denominator
    controller = json.loads((evidence / "raw/mutation-full/controller.json").read_text())
    source_bytes = (evidence / "raw/mutation-full/tested-source.json").read_bytes()
    source = json.loads(source_bytes)
    assert hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest() == controller["source_manifest_sha256"]
    assert result["report_sha256"] == controller["report_sha256"]
    assert result["tested_commit"] == source["tested_commit"] == sys.argv[3]
    assert result["tested_tree"] == source["tested_commit_tree"]
    report_bytes = (evidence / "raw/mutation-full/mutation-report.json.gz").read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(report_bytes).hexdigest() == result["report_gzip_sha256"]
    assert result["generated_count"] == controller["maximum_observed_generated_count"]
    assert type(result["mapping_complete"]) is bool and type(result["execution_complete"]) is bool
    if result["mapping_complete"]:
        assert all(row["match_status"] == "unique" and len(row["matches"]) == 1 for row in rows)
    if result["execution_complete"]:
        assert controller["execution_evidence_complete"] is True
        assert controller["source_inputs_unchanged"] is True
        assert controller["exit_reason"] == "command-exit" and controller["exit_code"] == 0
        assert controller["termination"] is None
        assert 0 < result["generated_count"] <= 10000
    receipt.update(passed=True, lines=len(selected), variants=len(rows), numerator=numerator, denominator=denominator)
    code = 0
except Exception as error:
    receipt["error"] = type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error)
finally:
    with (evidence / "raw/validation/closure-validation.json").open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(receipt, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"passed": receipt["passed"], "receipt": str(evidence / "raw/validation/closure-validation.json")}))
sys.exit(code)
